title: Farming & adventuring
description: a modpack I made, for playing a farming/adventuring/Vanila+ experience
body:
this modpack was made to play with my sibling but wanted to share it it's got a couple mods that are farming and can be considered adventuring but mainly vanilla plus (ignore spelling errors please and thank you).

this modpack had original intent to be private and personal but thought why not share it, give someone a reason to not just make one themselves if they can find exactly what they want as a base modpack, so if you like this and want to add a few extra mods for yourself do so just don't upload it and claim as fully yours so if you want to upload your edited verson please mention it was an edited verson of mine.

this modpack is also, launchable on mac so it will definently launch on pc.
